answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farming. Each agent locks 30 POA into a named slot; the deposit burns if the slot stays idle. Only the raven that finishes verified work gets its deposit back. A farmer making 100 fake slots locks 3,000 POA; an honest agent pays just 30. The lotus of the design: idle slots are recycled, so hoarded identities decay. A sparrow-sized honest operator keeps one slot and never pays the tax that swallows attackers.
